items.label: Intro & Init
items.content:
# Introduction & Initialization

**Overview:**
AIClient is a lightweight browser library for AI text and image generation. Include the library via script tag, and initialize with your API key.

**Include the library:**
```html
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/HyperRushNet/hrn-ai/client/1.0.3.min.js"></script>
```

**Initialize:**
```javascript
// Create the client instance
const client = new AIClient();

// Set your API key
client.setApiKey('YOUR_API_KEY');
```

**Tips:**
- Only for browser environments.
- Store your API key securely.
- Call initialization once per session.

items.label: Set Text Type
items.content:
# Set Text Type

**Essence:**
Configure AIClient to generate text.

**Code:**
```javascript
client.setType('text');
```

**Tips:**
- Always call before setting model or generating text.

items.label: Choose Text Model
items.content:
# Set Text Model

**Essence:**
Pick a model for text output.

**Code:**
```javascript
client.setModel('flux');
```

**Links:**
- [Models Page](https://enter.pollinations.ai/#:~:text=Models)
- [Model Health](https://model-monitor.pollinations.ai/)

**Tips:**
- Select a model based on your use case: story, assistant, code, etc.

items.label: Generate Text
items.content:
# Generate Text

**Essence:**
Send a prompt to generate text.

**Code:**
```javascript
const prompt = 'Write a motivational quote about AI.';
const output = await client.generate(prompt);
console.log(output);
```

**Tips:**
- Use `await` for async generation.
- Better prompts = better output.

items.label: Optional Functions
items.content:
# Optional Functions

**Enhance text generation with extra options:**

## setSystemPrompt
```javascript
client.setSystemPrompt('You are a helpful assistant.');
```
- Sets the AI’s persona.

## setTimeout
```javascript
client.setTimeout(30000);
```
- Maximum request time in milliseconds.

## setRetry
```javascript
client.setRetry(true, 2, 1000);
```
- Retry failed requests with count and delay.

items.label: Generate Image
Optional Functions
items.content:
# Optional Functions

**Enhance image generation with extra options:**

## setDimensions
```javascript
client.setDimensions(1024, 1024);
```
- Set width and height in pixels.

## setTimeout
```javascript
client.setTimeout(30000);
```
- Maximum generation time.

## setRetry
```javascript
client.setRetry(true, 2, 1000);
```
- Retry failed requests automatically.
